description_en: Modifies the maintenance window of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 修改AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的可维护时间
name: ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime

parameters.help_en: This parameter is no longer used
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需传入该参数
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the maintenance window. Specify the time in the HH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 可维护的开始时间。格式：HH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the maintenance window. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the HH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 可维护的结束时间，需要大于开始时间。格式：HH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time
